task.description: Diagnose and fix NFR-02 throughput benchmark failure found in release validation for IDN-01 (observed ~769 events/sec, required >=1000). Identify whether regression is caused by recent IDN-01 or related changes; optimize or correct the bottleneck; preserve functional correctness and security. Validate with zig build, zig build test, and zig build bench demonstrating NFR-02 >= 1000 events/sec.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause for NFR-02 throughput shortfall is identified
Fixes are applied with minimal risk
zig build bench exits 0 and reports NFR-02 throughput >= 1000 events/sec

result.summary: Fixed D-category benchmark harness bottleneck in NFR-02 throughput measurement by replacing per-row insert round-trips with parameterized batched inserts; validated zig build, zig build test, and zig build bench with NFR-02=40437.606 eps (>=1000).
